title: B2005 - B2005
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: The parameter data stored in the control unit is incorrect.
stepByStepSolution: Update the software with the factory scan tool ODIS, follow the instructions in TSB 2011732: 00 Software Version Management (SVM), operating instructions.
technicalNotes:
This fault usually means there's a bug in the factory firmware, parameter related data in the control unit is incorrect or parameter data is missing because the module has not been configured via SVM with a direct connection to VW/Audi headquarters.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the BA-Motor Mounts (J931) Kontrol Modülü (typically in conjunction with B2010) on Audi vehicles with 4.0T engine see:
NAR (North American) Market TPI 2036392
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2017/MC-10128212-9999.pdf  NHTSA
2013-2015 S6/S7/RS7/A8/R8 with 4.0T engine
RoW (Rest of World) Market TPI 2036309
Those TPIs discuss Audi SVM code BAA001 for the flash update in addition to a mechanical adjustment and Basic Setting procedure. The RoW document includes the S8 model.
